source: Owner Rules v2 + Part 4 Build & Test Brief (source-design-doc.md); names are placeholders. Cycle 1 revision: cards with a "changed" field were reworked (old text in "previous_text"); the sim hard-codes effects by id, so every changed id needs its effect re-coded. Format otherwise unchanged.

rules_constants.critical_mass_threshold_formula: 12 + number of players at setup, maximum 17; ST10 is 2 lower
rules_constants.mulligan: once, only if the opening 5 has no CO: shuffle hand into deck, draw 5
rules_constants.rotation_direction: active player chooses clockwise or counter-clockwise each Rotation Phase
rules_constants.recycle_play: as 1 of your 2 plays: discard 1 card from hand, draw 1

damage_density.note: Augmentation damage is counted per trigger. AE23 is modal (1 damage OR -1 Stability) and still counted. COs CO23 and CO30 also deal recurring damage but are not in the AE tally.

stars.text: Once per turn, you may discard a card to draw a different card.
Once per turn, you may move an Augmentation from one of your COs to another.
Whenever one of your COs is knocked into the Out of Orbit zone, you may draw a card.
While your total Size in orbit is 10 or greater, your COs gain +1 Stability.
Once per turn, if you have 3 or more COs in orbit, you may deal 1 damage to an opponent's Star.
Once per turn, when an opponent's effect knocks one of your COs out of orbit, you may deal 1 damage to that opponent's Star.
Once per turn, if this Star took damage since your last turn, you may deal 1 damage to an opponent's Star.

stars.previous_text: While a CO in your orbit has 2 or more Augmentations, it also has +1 Size.
stars.text: Each of your COs with 1 or more Augmentations attached has +1 Size.
Once per turn, you may reclaim a CO from the Out of Orbit zone into your orbit, even if a CO has already entered your orbit this turn.

stars.previous_text: Your Critical Mass threshold is 13 instead of 15.
stars.text: Your Critical Mass threshold is 2 lower than the table's. While your Critical Mass countdown is running, your COs have +1 Stability.

stars.previous_text: Whenever you reclaim a CO, it deals 1 damage to an opponent's Star.
stars.text: Active, once per turn: reclaim a CO with Size 3 or less from the Out of Orbit zone into your orbit (it still counts as your 1 CO this turn). Whenever you reclaim a CO, deal 1 damage to an opponent's Star.

stars.previous_text: Once per turn, when one of your COs is knocked out of orbit for any reason, you may deal 1 damage to an opponent's Star.
stars.text: Active, once per turn: choose an opponent's CO. It gets -1 Stability this turn.
